about_the_game:
Catchphrase & Introduction

A recurring dream... a vision of a future that cannot be undone. A future where the one you love is brutally murdered. In the heart of this nightmare, a man who wears his face leans in and whispers:

"Show me your sin."

For the color of that sin is the final, blasphemous key to awakening an ancient god.

Characters

[h3]Suzuno Kuretsuki:[/h3]

The protagonist. Her ordinary life as a rookie manager to a top star is shattered after an encounter with a figure known only as "the Painter" in her dreams. Dragged into a world of the surreal, she inexplicably finds herself in the body of her high school self.

[h3]Cain:[/h3]

The story's central character. As a top actor and the current sensation of the theater district, his life seems perfect. But with the run of his latest show complete, he confesses his deepest trouble to Suzuno—that he is tormented by nightmares every single night.

Game Overview

Your mission, as a rookie manager, is simple: guide the brilliant Hollywood star, Kane, to global stardom. He is perfect, dazzling, and the world adores him.

But his perfection is a flawless mask, hiding eyes as empty as glass. And then there are the nightmares... the same one, every single night.

In the light of day, you navigate the glittering facade of Broadway. In the dead of night, you roam the halls of a high school in your dreams, forced to unearth the "sins" buried within.

This is a cosmic horror adventure where a radiant, counterfeit reality collides with a nightmare beyond human understanding.

By day, you'll unravel the enigma of the actor Kane amidst the glamour of the entertainment industry. By night, you'll descend into the "Underworld," a nightmarish city choked with secrets and sin.

Behind it all, the shadows of Old Gods stir, eager to be born into this world. Your only guide is the manic diary left by your predecessor, a manager said to have taken his own life. With it, you will claw your way to the heart of a mythic conspiracy.

At a crucial juncture, a single, unforgivable "sin" will tear the story in two. Your choices will not only define your relationship with him but will shatter the story's conclusion, forging entirely different fates.

Will you grasp a fleeting hope to save the one you love? Or will your own "Original Sin" be the final pull of the trigger that ends the world?

Features

  • Hollywood Glamour Meets Cosmic Horror: A one-of-a-kind dark psychological thriller that blends the dazzling world of celebrities with spine-chilling Lovecraftian terror.

  • Your Choices Forge Your Madness: A deep, branching narrative where your decisions stain the protagonist's soul with a "Color of Sin," dragging the story into unique forms of insanity.

  • A Battle of Wits and Wills: Engage in breathless psychological standoffs with a cast of dangerously charismatic characters.

  • Heart-Pounding Adventure: Beautifully directed, high-stakes scenarios inspired by RPGs and escape games will test your nerve at critical moments. Your choices determine success or failure.

  • Sleek & Stylish UI: A meticulously designed, immersive user interface.

  • Multiple Fates Await: Will you find salvation in the end, or something far, far worse?

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3250U with Radeon Graphics
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX3050
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 10 互換サウンドカード

short_description: 「お前の罪を見せてみろ」―――その言葉から、悪夢は始まる。 あなたは新人マネージャーとして、完璧な俳優『ケイン』に隠された謎と、彼と瓜二つの『画家』が支配する悪夢の世界に挑む。 これは、あなたの「罪」と「選択」が物語を全く異なる二つの運命へと分岐させる、コズミックホラー・アドベンチャー。
